import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static int sum_mod(int a, int b) {
        a += b;
        if (a >= MOD) a -= MOD;
        return a;
    }

    static int mult_mod(int a, int b) {
        long res = 1L * a * b;
        if (res >= MOD) res %= MOD;
        return (int) res;
    }

    static class Mat {
        int N, M;
        int[][] data;

        public Mat(int N, int M) {
            this.N = N;
            this.M = M;
            data = new int[N][M];
        }

        void reset() {
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                    data[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void set_identity() {
            reset();
            int limit = Math.min(N, M);
            for (int i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
                data[i][i] = 1;
            }
        }

        Mat transpose() {
            Mat t = new Mat(M, N);
            t.reset();
            for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                    t.data[i][j] = data[j][i];
                }
            }
            return t;
        }

        int[] get_row(int r) {
            return data[r];
        }

        Mat add(Mat other) {
            Mat res = new Mat(N, M);
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                    res.data[i][j] = sum_mod(this.data[i][j], other.data[i][j]);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Mat multiply_by(int scalar) {
            Mat res = new Mat(N, M);
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                    res.data[i][j] = mult_mod(this.data[i][j], scalar);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        static Mat multiply(Mat a, Mat b) {
            int N = a.N;
            int M = b.M;
            int X = a.M;
            Mat out = new Mat(N, M);
            out.reset();
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < X; j++) {
                    if (a.data[i][j] != 0) {
                        for (int k = 0; k < M; k++) {
                            out.data[i][k] = sum_mod(out.data[i][k], mult_mod(a.data[i][j], b.data[j][k]));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return out;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int K = sc.nextInt();

        // Initialize arrays
        Mat[][] A = new Mat[65][35];
        Mat[][] S = new Mat[65][35];
        Mat[][] P = new Mat[65][35];

        for (int i = 0; i < 65; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 35; j++) {
                A[i][j] = new Mat(35, 35);
                S[i][j] = new Mat(35, 35);
                P[i][j] = new Mat(35, 35);
            }
        }

        // Initialize A[0][i]
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            A[0][i].set_identity();
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                A[0][i].data[i][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        long length = K;
        int i_idx = 1;
        while (length <= n) {
            // Compute S[i-1][j]
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                S[i_idx - 1][j] = new Mat(35, 35);
            }
            S[i_idx - 1][K - 1] = A[i_idx - 1][K - 1];
            for (int j = K - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                S[i_idx - 1][j] = Mat.multiply(A[i_idx - 1][j], S[i_idx - 1][j + 1]);
            }

            // Compute P[i-1][j]
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                P[i_idx - 1][j] = new Mat(35, 35);
            }
            P[i_idx - 1][0] = A[i_idx - 1][0];
            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                P[i_idx - 1][j] = Mat.multiply(P[i_idx - 1][j - 1], A[i_idx - 1][j]);
            }

            // Compute A[i][j]
            A[i_idx][0] = new Mat(35, 35);
            A[i_idx][0].set_identity();
            A[i_idx][0] = S[i_idx - 1][0];

            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                A[i_idx][j] = Mat.multiply(S[i_idx - 1][j], P[i_idx - 1][j - 1]);
            }

            length *= K;
            i_idx++;
        }

        // Convert n to base K digits
        int[] digits = new int[65];
        int len_digits = 0;
        long temp_n = n;
        while (temp_n > 0) {
            digits[len_digits++] = (int) (temp_n % K);
            temp_n /= K;
        }

        Mat ans = new Mat(35, 35);
        ans.set_identity();

        int s = 0;
        for (int idx = len_digits - 1; idx >= 0; idx--) {
            int digit = digits[idx];
            for (int j = 0; j < digit; j++) {
                ans = Mat.multiply(ans, A[idx][(j + s) % K]);
            }
            s = (s + digit) % K;
        }

        int res = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            res = sum_mod(res, ans.data[i][K]);
        }

        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
    }
}
